accessibility.contrast_requirements: All text in the wiki view must meet 4.5:1 against #ffffff. All monitor text must meet 4.5:1 against #0A0A0A.
accessibility.reduced_motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion for disk blinkers (use opacity change instead of fast pulse).

media.wiki_images: Must have gray border with explicit Wikipedia-style caption container below.

disk_hardware.description: Optical M-Disc for the Text and Media disk logical stores.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the application using pure React and Tailwind CSS. The files should be named .js (not .tsx) as per the stack.
Do NOT use 'Inter' for the Wikipedia reading view. Use system-ui/sans-serif for body and 'Linux Libertine'/Georgia/serif for H1/H2 to accurately simulate Wikipedia.

The Disk Monitor should sit on top or alongside the main view. It must feel like a radically different interface: pure black, monospace fonts, glowing green/amber text, simulating a hardware terminal.

Implement simulated 'streaming': when a user clicks an article, the UI should briefly show the Text Disk indicator blinking fast, then text renders. Moments later, the Media Disk indicator blinks, and the images pop in.
Create a home portal screen that looks like the Wikipedia Main Page but curated with offline articles (e.g., 'Today's featured article', 'In the news').
In the Wikipedia view, style links classically: #3366cc, underlined on hover. No modern pill buttons for links. Text layout is left-aligned.
All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='search-input', data-testid='toggle-monitor').
Do not use dark colors as gradients for the Wikipedia view. Maintain strict encyclopedic layout.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts. Wikipedia content should be left-aligned and highly structured.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container. Do not add '.App { text-align: center; }' in the css file.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 for icons.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable, but style them down to look like basic HTML components for the Wikipedia side.
Use sonner for toasts, located in /app/src/components/ui/sonner.js.
